page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring parallel processing capabilities. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with 48 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 186.0 GB of system memory. The instance is equipped with two NVIDIA T4 GPUs based on the Turing architecture, providing a total of 32 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached options, supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is relatively weak, as shown by a stress-ng single-core score of 1104.08 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.19 GB/sec. However, the 48 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 35393.62 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 149.01 GB/sec. Memory read-only bandwidth for large blocks is measured at 98.26 GB/sec, while write bandwidth is 44.08 GB/sec.

This hardware configuration is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that can leverage the dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs for parallel computing without requiring high single-thread CPU performance or local NVMe storage. The instance is suited for workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, and moderate parallel database operations, where multi-core processing and GPU acceleration offset the lower single-core efficiency.
